status: PROPOSAL by the voice-and-sound-director, 2026-10-28. Not used by any tool. The owner listens to the audition (docs/audio/voice-direction.md section 7) and decides; then the main assistant merges what he chose into content/voices.json. Reasons and sources: docs/audio/voice-direction.md.
note: Which ElevenLabs voice speaks for which character. voiceId values are the ones in content/voices.json today; 'brief' says what the voice should sound like, so the owner can pick a better one by ear. 'narrator' is the voice that says the lesson lines for the friend (app/lib/app/companion.dart); it must have the same gender as the friend's own voice.

request._note: seed makes a re-run of the same line much more alike (ElevenLabs: determinism is not guaranteed). Needs a small voice_gen change to be sent (section 6 of the markdown).

_stylesNote: speed is the base for Band B; the per-line speed in docs/audio/voice-direction.csv adds -0.03 for Band A and +0.03 for Band C. 'cheer_current' is today's cheer (content/voices.json), kept so the audition can compare it with the calmer proposal. Whether eleven_v4_turbo honours style and speed is not confirmed in the official docs (one secondary source says it does not); the audition tests it (section 7, set C).
_styleRulesNote: Rules are tried in this order; the first match wins (so vo:fb.unsure is gentle by the fb. rule unless the order is changed: put warm before gentle when the tool supports it). Today voice_gen only matches a prefix ('vo:...'); the '*.suffix' patterns, the per-line 'list' style and the band speed need the change in section 6. Until then, the per-line style and speed are in docs/audio/voice-direction.csv (columns style, speed).
_pronunciationNote: Each entry keeps the letters and only adds points, for one reading. They are PROPOSALS: the hebrew-text-editor confirms each pointing, and the audition (set B) checks whether ElevenLabs needs them at all. They must be matched as whole words: today's respelled() replaces substrings, so 'חסר' would also hit 'שחסר' and 'החסר' (section 6).

nitzi.role: flagship narrator (female): every lesson line, plus her own lines
nitzi.brief: warm young woman, mid pitch, a smile in the voice, very clear Israeli Hebrew, unhurried; a kind gan teacher or big sister, never a cartoon squeak

hero-son.role: flagship narrator (male): every lesson line, the live helper, plus his own lines
hero-son.brief: warm young man, light baritone, playful energy held in, very clear diction; an older cousin who loves to jump, not a child actor

alien-jili.brief: bubbly and bright, a little higher and faster than Nitzi, a soft wobble of fun; clearly a different person from Nitzi (today it is the same voice id)

climber-tzuri.brief: outdoorsy young man, upbeat and a bit breathy as if after a climb, friendly coach without shouting

compass-romi.brief: light, curious, younger-sister colour (a young adult voice, not a child), asks with a rising smile

friend-daughter.brief: soft and dreamy, a little slower, starlight calm; the gentlest of the cast

inventor-gali.brief: crisp and clever, mid-low pitch, quick but clear, an 'aha!' sparkle

tower-tamir.brief: deep, slow, gentle giant, low pitch, calm and safe

weaver-keshet.brief: warm older-sister woman, melodic, mid-low pitch, unhurried. CONFLICT: today she has Tamir's voice id (a voice in the male narrator's group); she needs a female voice of her own (owner question 1)
